Food  security  situation
*221. DR.  K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER  AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that food security
situation in the country  at present is not
comfortable;
(b) if so, the background of this serious
situation;
(c) whether it is due to controllable
factors  or uncontrollable factors; and
(d) the measures taken to tide over the
possible mishap and to avert similar
situations in future?
